propositions: The debug skill reads prior tickets but never writes back, leaving no trail of analysis or findings for future reference.
Step 7 sweeps by construct only, missing parity siblings that appear as absences invisible to grep.
Residual fragility from approved tickets is never reported, allowing fragmentation to persist uncaptured.
The skill must write back at four lifecycle points (RCA comment, reporting summary, not-a-bug classification, Step 7 siblings) with own-tracker writes ungated and third-party writes approval-gated.

Step 7 must decompose into two sweep axes: construct pattern matching (existing) and parity sibling detection via 4 forced-artifact questions (channel census across 5 surfaces plus per-surface probes).
Reporting must include a residual-risk disposition item with forced per-fragility choice (ticket, accepted-with-reason, or fixed-in-scope) or 'none observed'.
